propositions: Reconcile Bridge GitHub Action fails on live tickets branch because .bridge_state/projects.json was overwritten with rehearsal fixture containing nonexistent project keys LEG/ONE/TWO/ZERO instead of canonical empty projects mapping.

The fetcher multi-project fan-out (story-1734) builds JQL queries from all keys in projects.json; querying nonexistent project LEG triggers Jira rejection with 'value leg does not exist for field project', causing ACLI abort and pass exit 1.

Ad-hoc git commits (9f1b2cff98 + 275bd7507e) by test-fixture identity (t@t.co) corrupted live tickets branch .bridge_state/projects.json at 2026-08-14T19:18-0700, 21 minutes before first consistent Reconcile Bridge failure onset at 2026-08-15T02:39Z.
Bridge state writes lack atomic transaction guarantees (no shared write lock, no auto-commit, no auto-push), forcing ad-hoc hand-commits and enabling the data corruption.

Live origin/tickets:.bridge_state/projects.json must be restored to canonical single-project state {version:1, legacy_default:REB, projects:{}} and verified via rebar bridge preview and next scheduled Reconcile Bridge run.
